sloka: तां श्रुत्वा करुणां वाचं पितुर्मरणसंहिताम् ।राघवो भरतेनोक्तां बभूव गतचेतन: ॥ २.१०२.१॥
transliteration: tāṁ śrutvā karuṇāṁ vācaṁ piturmaraṇasaṁhitām ।rāghavo bharatenoktāṁ babhūva gatacetana: ॥ 2.102.1॥

translations.english: Having heard the words of Bharata regarding the death of his father, Rama became unconscious.
